The terms **Region Syddanmark** and **Syddanmark** refer to the same administrative and geographical entity in [[danmark|Danmark]] (the Region of Southern Denmark). In the national clinical quality reports for [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark) published in 2023 and 2024, the region is evaluated under both names across various healthcare quality indicators. It is one of the five Danish regions analyzed at the regional level, appearing as a distinct row in national results tables, and it contributes comprehensive clinical data to the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]].

### Clinical Performance and Indicators
Region Syddanmark demonstrates strong compliance with several national clinical standards. For [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which tracks the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients receiving an echocardiogram within a defined period, the region successfully meets the [[standard-80-percent|Standard: ≥80 %]]. In the 2023 report, the region achieved a compliance rate of 82.2% (95% CI: 80.9–83.4) [^src13], and in the 2024 report, it maintained compliance with a rate of 84.4% [^src7]. Similarly, for [[indikator-4a|Indikator 4a]], the region met the standard with a rate of 90.5% [^src15], and local health clusters such as [[sundhedsklynge-lillebaelt|Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt]] also fulfilled the requirements for [[indikator-4b|Indikator 4b]] [^src28]. For [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]], the region recorded an incidence rate of 0.7% (95% CI: 0.6–0.8), thereby meeting the standard [^src2]. Furthermore, the region reported a 90.5% result for Indikator 1 in the period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023 [^src12].

However, the region faces systemic challenges alongside the rest of the country regarding [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]]. Across all Danish regions, including Syddanmark, the standard for this indicator was not met, with regional compliance rates varying between 71% and 82% [^src14]. Additionally, while the region generally performs well, there is a noted slight downward trend in certain proportions, with a decrease of 0.4 percentage points observed in Region Syddanmark in recent reporting cycles [^src29].

### Healthcare Infrastructure and Clusters
The region's healthcare delivery is distributed across several major hospitals and specialized clinics. Facilities operating within Syddanmark include [[esbjerg-sygehus-grindsted-sygehus|Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus]], [[kolding-sygehus|Kolding Sygehus]], [[ouh-odense-universitetshospital|OUH Odense Universitetshospital]], [[sygehus-soenderjylland|Sygehus Sønderjylland]], [[vejle-sygehus|Vejle Sygehus]], [[sygehus-lillebaelt|Sygehus Lillebælt]], and the private [[friklinikken-region-syddanmark-grindsted|Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted]] [^src16]. 

Administratively and operationally, the region is subdivided into various health clusters (*sundhedsklynger*) and local clusters (*klynger*). These include [[sundhedsklynge-fyn|Sundhedsklynge Fyn]], [[sundhedsklynge-lillebaelt|Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt]], [[sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland]], [[sundhedsklynge-syd|Sundhedsklynge Syd]], [[sundhedsklynge-sydvestjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sydvestjylland]], [[sundhedsklyngen-suh|Sundhedsklyngen SUH]], [[klynge-syd|Klynge SYD]], and [[klynge-vest|Klynge VEST]] [^src8] [^src26]. *(Note: The extracted data also maps [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] under Syddanmark in specific tabular extractions [^src8] [^src26], though geographically Bornholm is typically associated with the Capital Region).*

### Diagnostic Practices and Reporting
In terms of specific diagnostic coding and laboratory practices, the code [[npu18016-p-creatinin|npu18016-p-creatinin]] is predominantly utilized in Region Syddanmark and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] compared to other Danish regions [^src28]. The region actively participates in national quality improvements and provides structured feedback; however, in recent reporting cycles, Region Syddanmark submitted no additional comments regarding the [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] database results [^src11].
